Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome For The Board Meeting Held On July 24, 2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited issued its annual report for the financial year 2025-26, convening its 36th Annual General Meeting for July 30, 2026. The management detailed statutory items, executive remuneration structures, and sought material related party transaction approvals with entities such as Tata Motors Limited, Fiat India Automobiles Private Limited, and Tata AutoComp Hendrickson Suspensions Private Limited. Financial highlights and corporate governance disclosures were duly presented alongside administrative resolutions. This document contains the notice for the 35th Annual General Meeting of Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited for the financial year 2024-25, detailing resolutions for the adoption of financial statements, appointment of auditors, and approval of various related-party transactions. Management has outlined estimated annual values for transactions with group entities and related parties like Tata Motors, Tata AutoComp, and others.

management_commitments.claim: The company appointed M/s SVD and Associates as Secretarial Auditors for a term of 5 consecutive years from FY 2025-26 to FY 2029-30.
management_commitments.quote: RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Regulation 24A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with the provisions of Section 204(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 and Rule 9 of the Companies (Appointment and Remuneration of Managerial Personnel) Rules, 2014 and other applicable provisions, if any, of the Companies Act, 2013, (including any statutory modification(s) or re-enactment(s) thereof for the time being in force) and as per the recommendations of Audit Committee and the Board of Directors of the Company, consent of the Members be and is hereby accorded for appointment of M/s SVD and Associates, Company Secretaries, Pune (Peer reviewed Certificate No. 6357/2025) as the Secretarial Auditors of the Company to hold office for a period of 5 (Five) consecutive years commencing from the financial year 2025-26 to financial year 2029-30.

management_commitments.claim: The company approved related party transactions with Tata Motors Limited up to an estimated annual value of 350 Crore for the period from the ensuing AGM till the AGM for FY 2025-26.
management_commitments.quote: RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Board of Directors of the Company be and is hereby authorized to negotiate and finalize other terms and conditions and to do all such acts, deeds, matters and things including but not limited to delegation of powers as may be necessary, proper or expedient to give effect to this Resolution.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
